hero_kpi_rationale: Collectibles revenue is a key segment of the business, growing 47.7% in 2025 and now representing 29.2% of total net sales, up from 18.8% the prior year. This rapid expansion illustrates GameStop's strategic transformation beyond traditional video game retail.

kpis.name: Collectibles Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of collectibles (trading cards, figurines, collectible items)
kpis.description: Collectibles revenue increased by 47.7% in 2025, rising from $717.9M to $1,060.2M, representing 29.2% of total net sales (versus 18.8% the previous year).

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of net sales remaining after deducting cost of goods sold
kpis.description: Gross margin improved by 390 basis points in 2025, increasing from 29.1% to 33.0%, primarily driven by a favorable product mix (higher-margin collectibles).

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.description: Net sales declined by 5.1% in 2025, decreasing from $3,823.0M to $3,629.9M, primarily due to lower software sales (-27.5%) and hardware sales (-12.3%), partially offset by growth in collectibles.

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Operating profit after deduction of operating expenses
kpis.description: Operating income improved from a loss of $26.2M in 2024 to a profit of $232.1M in 2025 (6.4% of net sales), driven by gross margin expansion and a $220.2M reduction in SG&A expenses.

kpis.name: Net Interest Income
kpis.explanation: Net interest income generated from cash and investments
kpis.description: Net interest income increased by 66.2% in 2025, rising from $163.4M to $271.5M, driven by proceeds from convertible note issuances and active cash management.

risks.title: Stock Price Volatility
risks.summary: The company's stock price has experienced extreme volatility, often disconnected from its actual performance, which may affect investor confidence.
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly mentions extreme volatility in GME's stock price, citing the 2021 short squeeze as a major example. This volatility is considered disproportionate to operational performance, indicating a significant risk for shareholders. The 'Capital' category is weighted as it directly affects valuation and market perception. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Dependence on Video Game and Hardware Sales
risks.summary: Declines in video game and computer hardware sales, although offset by collectibles, pose a risk if these traditional markets continue to contract.
risks.score_rationale: Data shows significant declines in 'Hardware and accessories' (-12.3%) and 'Software' (-27.5%) in 2025. While 'Collectibles' are growing, the sharp decline in traditional categories indicates a dependency that becomes a risk if these markets keep shrinking. The 'Industrial' category is relevant as it pertains to the core product sales business. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Data Protection Risks
risks.summary: Protecting data and systems from cyberattacks is critical, and any breach could have severe consequences for the company and its customers.
risks.score_rationale: Although the document details governance measures and a dedicated cybersecurity team, the mere emphasis on the importance of these controls and the reference to Item 1A for further details ('for additional information about the risks to our business associated with a breach or compromise to our data and information security systems') suggest the risk is significant. The 'Cybersecurity' category is high priority for any technology-facing company. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Optimization and Restructuring of International Operations
risks.summary: The company's strategy involves closures and divestitures of international operations, which may result in restructuring costs and impact overall revenue.
risks.score_rationale: The text mentions the divestiture of operations in Canada and New Zealand, as well as the closure of operations in Germany and Italy. These restructurings led to significant asset impairments and reduced sales in certain regions. The 'Macro' category applies as it covers strategic geographic expansion/contraction decisions. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Lease and Store Location Management
risks.summary: The company must manage the expiration of numerous store and distribution center leases, which could lead to costs or disruptions if negotiations fail.
risks.score_rationale: The document details the upcoming expiration of leases for numerous stores and distribution centers in the coming years. While the company expresses confidence in renewals or relocations, poor management of these expirations could result in unexpected costs or operational disruptions. The 'Industrial' category applies to commercial real estate and operational logistics. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Risk Related to Digital Assets and Cryptocurrencies
risks.summary: The company incurred significant losses related to digital assets, highlighting the volatility and risks associated with these technology investments.
risks.score_rationale: The report mentions a significant loss on digital assets and related receivables ($131.6 million), indicating exposure to the volatility and inherent risks of this market. The 'Technology' category is relevant for digital assets. (default score, to be refined)
